selection.name: Worktrunk (C09)
selection.role: Separate Git working directories and manage their lifecycle for parallel Claude Code and Codex edits.
selection.install_command: curl --proto '=https' --tlsv1.2 -LsSf https://github.com/max-sixty/worktrunk/releases/download/v0.80.0/worktrunk-installer.sh | sh && wt config shell install

basis.shows: Separate worktrees, agent launch commands and lifecycle hooks directly meet edit separation. Documents cargo test and the shell integration test suite; passing CI outcomes were not verified.

Released 2026-09-27; supplies Linux x86_64 and macOS arm64 binaries and the pinned installer. Reports picker work beginning at 47ms versus 120ms in a 50-worktree repository with macOS optimization context. This measures its own versions, not competitor superiority or containment.
Unarchived; 48 open issue/PR items. Release notes document recent bug fixes and issue-response activity; response latency was not measured.

selection.name: sandbox-runtime (C01)
selection.role: Provisional process sandbox for tasks requiring enforced filesystem and network restrictions; callable through srt by either agent.
selection.install_command:
sudo apt-get install bubblewrap socat ripgrep
npm install -g @anthropic-ai/sandbox-runtime@0.0.78
selection.install_source: Upstream README npm installation and Linux dependency instructions, with the package version pinned to the verified latest release v0.0.78.

basis.shows: Documents Linux bubblewrap filesystem restrictions, network namespace isolation and filtering proxies; macOS Seatbelt support; x64/arm64 Linux seccomp binaries; and a command-wrapping CLI developed for Claude Code. Reads are unrestricted by default, so secret-read restrictions need explicit policy. Documents npm test and Linux architecture testing in CI, without verified current pass results.

Released 2026-09-30. Records test-validity repairs, seccomp typecheck repair, write-boundary regression tests and a Linux deny-path concurrency fix. Demonstrates active corrective maintenance, not measured containment superiority.
Unarchived; 262 open issue/PR items. Upstream describes a research preview, warranting a provisional boundary recommendation.
Latest default-branch commit dated 2026-10-01, within the frozen 90-day window.

excluded.fact: The upstream repository identifies a Mac-hosted VM tool optimized for Apple silicon, which cannot supply the required primary WSL2 Linux installation. It fits the secondary Mac platform. Unarchived; commit September 30, release 1.5.0 September 29, 551 open issue/PR items. Source: https://api.github.com/repos/apple/container.

layers.deciding_comparison: Hold Worktrunk constant and compare sandbox-runtime v0.0.78 with rootless Podman v6.1.3 on the intended untrusted workload in the specified WSL2 Ubuntu host. Match permitted files and network destinations; test forbidden reads/writes, egress and IPC, resource exhaustion, task completion, descendant termination and residual state after exit/crash. Measure startup overhead and compatibility failures, then repeat relevant checks on macOS arm64. The selected pair reflects documented capability fit; no measured boundary winner is established.
evidence_gaps: The packet records no comparison where the relevant arms all ran. Selection of the enforced boundary remains provisional rather than a claim of measured superiority.
Current CI pass results and comparative containment benchmarks were not verified. Documented test commands and release-recorded regression tests demonstrate test activity, not passing outcomes.

Actual WSL2 execution was not tested. sandbox-runtime documents Ubuntu 24.04+ AppArmor/user-namespace prerequisites; its macOS arm64 execution was not verified. VM virtualization prerequisites and alternative repositories' detailed platform/install documentation remain incomplete.

CPU/memory quota enforcement was not found in sandbox-runtime's inspected README or latest release notes. Workloads requiring those controls remain part of the deciding comparison. The written layer does not require GPU computation.

All nine repositories passed archive and 90-day default-branch freshness checks. Open issue counts include pull requests and do not establish maintenance responsiveness; response-time measurements were unavailable.
